companyDescription: DNA medicine biotech · INO-3107 for HPV-related recurrent respiratory papillomatosis (RRP) · PDUFA Oct 2026, FDA review progressing with no new issues raised · deep penny-stock-territory valuation
priceNote: Down 2.84% today (self-fetched — not yet in live-prices.json cache, new pick this run). Down 44.44% over the past 3 months and trading near the 52-week low of $1.04. Tiny market cap ($97.49M) — genuinely deep speculative territory.
summary: Inovio's lead candidate INO-3107 (DNA medicine for HPV-related recurrent respiratory papillomatosis, a rare and debilitating throat condition with no approved systemic treatment) remains on track for an October 2026 PDUFA date, with FDA review progressing and no new issues raised as of the latest update. Analyst targets show real dispersion — a 5-analyst Buy-consensus average of $8.80 (542% upside from today's crashed price) alongside a more conservative 2-analyst Hold view at $4.50 (228% upside). ⚠️ SURVIVAL: cash runway extends only into Q1 2027 (roughly 6-9 months from today) and the company holds an effective $300M shelf registration it has already drawn on this year (a $17.5M underwritten offering in April 2026). Included in top 5 despite the flag because the PDUFA date is an unusually close, real binary regulatory event for a stock this cheap — see justification below.

catalysts.name: INO-3107 PDUFA Decision
catalysts.description: FDA target action date for INO-3107 in RRP. Review has progressed with no new issues raised as of the latest company update — a genuinely de-risked-relative-to-typical-biotech regulatory setup, though nothing is final until the decision itself.

catalysts.name: Pipeline Data Presentations (ASGCT/ASCO)
catalysts.description: R&D data presentations for INO-5401 and VGX-3100 rejuvenation efforts add secondary, less-binary catalysts alongside the main PDUFA story.

risks: ⚠️ SURVIVAL: cash runway extends only into Q1 2027 (~6-9 months from today) after a $16M equity raise, and the company holds an effective $300M shelf registration that it already drew on in April 2026 ($17.5M underwritten offering with warrants at $1.40/share). Note: the company's specific ATM sales-agreement prospectus was separately suspended — the dilution risk here is via the broader shelf/underwritten-offering route, not an active daily ATM.
This is a genuinely tiny, deep-penny-stock-territory name ($97.49M market cap, $1.37 share price) — extreme volatility is structural, not incidental; the stock is already down 44.44% over 3 months

Analyst target dispersion is stark — 5 analysts average $8.80 (Buy) vs. 2 analysts at $4.50 (Hold) — the Hold view exists for real reasons (financing overhang, execution history) and shouldn't be dismissed just because the Buy average is more exciting

Even a clean PDUFA approval doesn't automatically solve the financing problem — Inovio would still need a commercial launch partner or additional capital to actually monetize INO-3107, and the market may discount this at the moment of approval

RRP is a rare condition — even with approval, peak sales estimates are modest in absolute dollar terms, meaning the re-rate ceiling is real but not unlimited the way a broader-indication drug's would be
